episodes.title: Ursus maritimus
episodes.summary: Jane, David, and Greybeard track a polar bear in the Arctic Circle, inspiring Jane to convince her neighbor Mr. Jin to see trash differently.

episodes.title: Carcharodon carcharias
episodes.summary: While trying to tag a great white shark, Jane urges David's dad and Tata to rethink how they shop for groceries.

episodes.title: Apis mellifera
episodes.summary: David shrinks Jane and Greybeard to honeybee size to explore a hive. But when a schoolmate threatens the bees, Jane swoops in.

episodes.title: Acerodon jubatus
episodes.summary: The trio take off on a mission to aid the flying fox when Greybeard accidentally parachutes into a neighbor's yard.

episodes.title: Gavialis gangeticus
episodes.summary: Jane, David, and Greybeard try to sniff out why the gharial has a bulbed snout. A day at the pool points Jane toward an answer.

episodes.title: Balaenoptera musculus
episodes.summary: The three friends travel deep into the ocean to figure out why the blue whale sings, and Jane confronts a litterbug with a gifted voice.

episodes.title: Danaus plexippus
episodes.summary: A bug-sized Jane and Greybeard follow a monarch butterfly's journey to Mexico, leading Jane to seek assistance from Mr. Patel's green thumb.

episodes.title: Diceros bicornis
episodes.summary: Jane, David, and Greybeard monitor a black rhino and a red-billed oxpecker, whose relationship teaches them the value of teamwork.

episodes.title: Rangifer tarandus
episodes.summary: Chasing a herd of caribou stirs up David's appetite. At lunch, David's grandpa tells a story about respect, responsibility, and sharing.

episodes.title: Panthera tigris
episodes.summary: Jane and David stay up past their bedtime to track a tiger that prefers to come out at night, and they stumble upon something in the garden shed.

episodes.title: Ailuropoda melanoleuca
episodes.summary: Jane, David, and Greybeard must reunite a lost baby panda with its mother—and find out why they're the only bears with six fingers.

episodes.title: Canis lupus
episodes.summary: Tracking a wolf in the snowy mountains leads the trio to their neighbor's pug, who helps connect the dots between wolves, dogs, and people.

episodes.title: Chlamyphorus truncatus
episodes.summary: The three friends use their underground vessel to observe the elusive pink fairy armadillo, but a garden problem stops them in their tracks.

episodes.title: Anthozoa
episodes.summary: While exploring the Great Barrier Reef to determine if coral is a plant or an animal, the trio learn that looks can be deceiving.

episodes.title: Panthera leo
episodes.summary: With David sick in bed, Jane must partner with an unexpected ally to save Greybeard from a pride of lions.

episodes.title: Hippopotamus amphibius
episodes.summary: Jane, David, and Greybeard set off to find out why hippos give birth away from their pods, while trying to reunite a baby hippo with her mom.

episodes.title: Lasiorhinus krefftii
episodes.summary: The trio head underground to dig into wombat defense tactics. Jane wants the community BBQ menu to explore new options.

episodes.title: Diomedea exulans
episodes.summary: David joins Jane on a high-flying mission to chart an albatross' journey instead of helping his sister Millie.

episodes.title: Loxodonta africana
episodes.summary: Jane convinces her reluctant abuela to help get a baby elephant back to his family, where she uncovers why herds follow a matriarch.

episodes.title: Pan troglodytes
episodes.summary: Jane and Greybeard lose hope when they see how humans impact chimpanzees in the wild, but David and a special friend restore her faith.
